parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??input; const economics=input.economics??deal.economics??{}; const expected=Number(economics.net_profit??0); const actual=Number(input.actual_net_profit??input.realized_net_profit??expected); const evidence=Array.isArray(input.profit_evidence)?input.profit_evidence:[]; const verified=input.profit_verified===true||input.verification_status==='verified'; const closed=['closed','funded','recorded','completed'].includes(String(input.closing_outcome??input.outcome??'').toLowerCase()); const discrepancy=Math.abs(actual-expected); const tolerance=Number(input.profit_tolerance??1); const reconciled=discrepancy<=tolerance; const status=verified&&closed&&reconciled?'verified_closeout':(!closed?'closeout_pending':(!reconciled?'profit_discrepancy':'verification_required')); const route=status==='verified_closeout'?'WF-044 CRM closeout/performance reporting':status==='profit_discrepancy'?'human_review':'WF-138 post-close profit performance controller'; return [{json:{workflow_id:'WF-139',workflow_name:'Post-Close Profit Verification → CRM Closeout & Performance Record',status,route,deal_id:deal.id??deal.deal_id??null,lead_id:deal.lead_id??null,property_id:deal.property_id??null,buyer_id:deal.buyer_id??null,profit_verification:{expected_net_profit:expected,actual_net_profit:actual,discrepancy, tolerance, reconciled,verified,evidence_count:evidence.length},closeout:{closed,ready_for_crm_closeout:status==='verified_closeout'},next_workflow:route,crm_activity:{event_type:'post_close_profit_verification_closeout',outcome:status,route,deal_id:deal.id??deal.deal_id??null},idempotency_key:'wf-139:profit-verification:'+(deal.id??deal.deal_id??input.event_id??'unknown')}}}];
